content: With regular sentences monolingual translation does not seem useful, as its behaviour mainly consists of copying. However, when the input sentence has characteristics unseen or rarely seen by the model at training time (like grammatical errors or different stylistic choices) – the decoder still generates the more regular version of the sentence (thus fixing the errors or adapting the style). Furthermore, in case of multilingual multi-domain NMT BIBREF12 , it is possible to switch between different domains or styles at runtime, thus performing “monolingual domain adaptation” or style transfer.
